harassment.name: Harassment
harassment.text: Hi {user}, your {type} on {where} was reported for harassment. Personal attacks break our community rules. This is a formal warning, and further reports may lead to a ban.

spam.name: Spam / self-promotion
spam.text: Hi {user}, your {type} on {where} contains promotional links. Self-promotion isn't allowed here. Please remove similar posts.

offTopic.name: Off-topic flooding
offTopic.text: Hi {user}, repeated low-effort replies like the one on {where} disrupt threads for everyone. Please keep replies on topic.

uncredited.name: Uncredited work
uncredited.text: Hi {user}, your {type} on {where} uses someone else's work without credit. Please credit the original creator or remove it.

repeatedHarassment.name: Repeated harassment
repeatedHarassment.text: You have been banned for {duration} for repeated harassment after prior warnings. Your {type} on {where} was the deciding report.

spamAccount.name: Spam account
spamAccount.text: This account has been banned for posting spam, including your {type} on {where}.

banEvasion.name: Ban evasion
banEvasion.text: This account is linked to a previously banned account and has been banned for ban evasion.

phishing.name: Phishing / impersonation
phishing.text: This account has been banned for impersonating staff and asking members for login details on {where}.

hateSpeech.name: Hate speech
hateSpeech.text: You have been banned for {duration} for hateful language in your {type} on {where}.

ruleViolation.name: Removed: rule violation
ruleViolation.text: Your {type} on {where} was removed because it breaks our community rules.

copyright.name: Removed: copyright
copyright.text: Your {type} on {where} was removed after a copyright report. You can post it again with credit or the creator's permission.

duplicate.name: Duplicate report
duplicate.text: Duplicate of a report that was already handled.
